span.p:
Route 53
Bangalore se US, 300 ms
-> har region me data ki copy, user apne paas wale region se padhe
Route 53 paas ka region bataye (multi-region)
US celeb ka tweet -> garam tweet India cache me bhi
poora region gira -> zinda region, feed thodi purani
dono region me likha -> baad wala jeete (last write wins)
